## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the new behaviour
- [ ] If I touched `art/`: `npm run art:build` and `npm run art:check`, and I looked at the result
- [ ] New visible feature: its own screenshot added to the README; change visible in the existing images: regenerated (`npm run screenshots`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No raw hook data (prompts, file contents, commands, tool responses) reaches the state, the browser or the disk
- [ ] Docs updated (README, STYLE.md, AGENTS.md) if behaviour or conventions changed
